interactions.assay: surface plasmon resonance (SPR) · dissociation constant KD
interactions.note: The affinity of epitope-specific Ab40 for binding to hepatocyte growth factor activator was determined by surface plasmon resonance. The affinity of Ab40 was 64-fold greater compared to the parent antibody Ab39 (KD = 10.3 nM). The affinity was reduced 8-fold for binding to HGFA with peptidic inhibitor, Ac-KQLR-chloromethylketone, covalently bound to the active site (KD = 1.35 nM; k on = 3.2 x 10^5 M^-1s^-1; k off = 4.3 x 10 ^-4 s^-1).
